roman_niche_2_stratigraphic_provenance_m.stratigraphic_chain: closed Roman niche 2 -> UE15304 upper organic/offering layer -> UE15307 lower protective layer -> six limestone boxes with lids + llim balls + Demotic texts
roman_niche_2_stratigraphic_provenance_m.strongest_admissible_claim: A sealed/closed Roman niche context preserves a stratified offering/protection assemblage in which six lidded limestone boxes containing llim balls occur in the lower protective layer. This is an excavated context, not a free-standing museum association.

manufacturing_equipment_gate.question_scope: physical production/manufacturing equipment inside the Oxyrhynchus Osireion excavation record
manufacturing_equipment_gate.scope_boundary: This negative applies to the excavated Oxyrhynchus Osireion record discussed by Mascort. It does not prove that no comparable manufacturing equipment existed elsewhere in Egypt or at another Osireion, nor that ritual simulacra were not manufactured elsewhere before deposition.

storage_provenance.catalogue_state: No separate catalogue beyond thesis material volume, 2018 publication, and conference article according to Maite

next_gates.objective: Recover the complete material cards and image pages for fichas 141, 253, 262, 329-331 and 343-351; map each ficha to object, dimensions, material, inscription, restoration state, image and exact find context.
Extract and compare Demotic texts on the six niche-2 boxes and other closed box examples to identify repeated protection/cardinal/deity operators without inferring contents beyond the inscriptions.
Locate the catalogue cards or photographs for gold-leaf-bearing magic balls and determine whether gold is surface foil, fragmentary residue, wrapping, inclusion or adjacent material.

canonical_seal: OXyrhynchus Roman niche 2 provides a stratified closed-context control: upper organic/offering layer over a lower protective layer containing six lidded limestone boxes with mud/llim balls and Demotic texts. Maite Mascort independently confirms about nine closed boxes at the site, some painted balls and gold leaf on a few, while directly denying physical manufacturing equipment in the excavated Osireion. Individual ficha-to-object mapping remains partial and must not be guessed.
